_meta.description: SciWorld object_type -> candidate room(s) prior for the location-WM router. Marginalized over task family (NOT keyed on task type). Rooms are the UNION of every room a type can occupy across all task generators + the base scene; the loader spreads probability UNIFORMLY over the union (P(room|type)). Keys are surface object-type tokens as they appear in `look around` observations (lowercased).
_meta.provenance: Transcribed from allenai/ScienceWorld v1.1.3: environments/BuildingMaker.scala (base scene) + tasks/specifictasks/Task*.scala (target objects). See wiki/syntheses/sciworld-wm-design.md and memory sciworld-placement-model.md.
_meta.notes: Types placed in a per-variation-random container within a fixed room still resolve to that one room here (container level is out of scope for the first build). Multi-room entries are types whose ROOM varies across variations/families; uniform over the union is the first-cut prior (SK 2026-07-09).

_comment_state_of_matter: task-1 change-of-state (boil/melt/freeze): room fixed per substance.
_comment_conductivity_thermometer: task-2a conductivity targets cycle {workshop,kitchen,living room}; task-10 thermometer targets cycle {living room,bedroom,bathroom}; union taken per type. Some also appear in the base scene.
_comment_electrical: task-2 power-component / circuit: all parts fixed to workshop. task-2a unknown-substance: workshop only.
_comment_categories: task-3 find-* targets are CATEGORIES ('animal', 'plant', 'living thing'), not a specific type; map the category to its room. Non-living-thing / living-thing can be anywhere, so fall back to uniform (omitted).
_comment_find_lifespan_lifestages: task-3 / task-6 / task-7: animals -> outside, plants/trees -> greenhouse (fixed per category).
_comment_grow_mendelian: task-4 grow-plant: seed jar cycles {kitchen,bathroom,living room,bedroom,workshop,greenhouse} (task desc usually names it; parse-desc preferred, this is the fallback). task-9 mendelian: seed jar fixed to greenhouse.
_comment_chemistry_paint: task-5 chemistry-mix inputs -> {kitchen,workshop}; excluded items (water, paints) at base scene. task-5 mix-paint cups -> {art studio, workshop}.
_comment_inclined_plane: task-8 inclined-plane: planes/blocks/stopwatch fixed to workshop.
_comment_instruments: Instruments (not usually the search target, but useful for `where is`): thermometer -> kitchen.
